fact: In a draft directive of November 2025 the SARB proposes that issuers of e-money above R5 million average monthly transaction value apply to the Reserve Bank for authorisation as Tier 1 e-money issuers in an interoperable payment system.
title: Directive in respect of specific payment activities within the national payment system (draft for consultation, Directive X of 2025)
publisher: South African Reserve Bank, National Payment System Department
